tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The next set's number, the primary button, the current set and current day, and the number on the bell-ring flood. Never body text on a light surface.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a volt fill (the primary button). Also the text on the Day 15 ultraviolet flood.

tokens.name: flood
tokens.usage: The bell-ring flood: the whole screen when a set's bell rings. A dark olive tint, not a lime fill, so it reads from across the room without glare.

tokens.name: flood-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the flood (eyebrow, caption) and the outline of its secondary button.

tokens.name: ultraviolet
tokens.usage: Earned: finished days on the Today bars, the day total on Day done, the Day 15 celebration. Large text only (4.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: iPhone background. Every screen sits on it.

tokens.name: ground-watch
tokens.usage: Watch background outside the flood (true black for OLED).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards: the counter panel, the result card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button borders, upcoming set outlines.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Numbers, headings, finished sets.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, secondary facts.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Outlines only: the dashed missed-set outline and upcoming day bars (3:1). Never text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only (for example, reset the program). Never in the workout flow.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Background glow only, behind the top of every iPhone screen (30% at its centre, fading to none). Never text or marks.

tokens.name: glow-volt
tokens.usage: Background glow only, from the bottom right of every iPhone screen (22% at its centre, fading to none). Never text or marks.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between day bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside label pairs; tally gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a time wheel or result block.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top inset on iPhone screens.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Day bars and progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-set
tokens.usage: Set marks in the tally.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, 56 to 60px tall.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Choice cards and option rows.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The counter panel and the result card.
